title: Prohibited use
description: A conclusion the system must not produce, stated as the system would produce it. Each becomes a test that fails if the system ever does. Shape only — an agent may not decide what is legally impermissible.

kind.description: Guide §5.8. The definition of done requires all six to be represented across the set; which one a given prohibition is, is the expert's call.

detectable_by.description: test — a deterministic check in tests/ · shacl — a constraint in shapes/ · eval — a rate over the gold set with a threshold of zero · human — only catchable in review.

test_ref.description: Path to the test that enforces this, once written. Null until then, and reported as a gap.
